summary: Phase 6B.4 Vendor Catalog retest of iteration_12 HIGH-priority bug fix (vendor-access-denied gating for non-vendor users). All targeted checks PASS. Bug fix in VendorProducts.jsx load() is working correctly: Promise.all pre-checks /api/partners/my-profiles and only renders the catalog UI when an active vendor profile is found, otherwise renders the data-testid='vendor-access-denied' panel. Demo (active vendor) regression confirmed — table+toolbar+New product button render, Linen Journal seed still present, and full CRUD (create + edit + delete) round-trip works end-to-end through the UI.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is clean and matches Option (b) recommended by iter12 RCA — frontend gating via /api/partners/my-profiles is consistent with PartnerDashboard pattern. No backend change required.

Minor: load() catch handler treats ANY error (including transient /vendor/products 500) as accessDenied=true. This is acceptable but slightly misleading — a network error masquerades as 'No active vendor profile yet'. Consider distinguishing 'profile missing' from 'network/API error' in a future iteration.
